title: capture_rtsp_multi
description: Captures one or more RTSP camera streams with FFmpeg and forwards compressed video and audio packets downstream.

streams.description: Streams to capture; when absent the top-level object is read as a single stream.

url.description: RTSP URL of the camera stream; credentials may be given separately.

stream_id.description: Stream id stamped on frames; defaults to the entry's position in the list.

transport.description: RTSP transport passed to FFmpeg as rtsp_transport.

hw_decode.description: Set up a hardware device for this stream when the platform has one.

max_retry_attempts.description: Consecutive failed connects before giving up; 0 or negative retries forever.

retry_delay_ms.description: Parsed but unused; the built-in reconnect backoff sets retry timing.

username.description: Camera username, joined to the URL only when the stream is opened.

password.description: Camera password, joined to the URL only when the stream is opened.
